titulo: A hundred, a thousand, a million
intro: Big numbers for prices, years and populations, and the ordinals first, second and third.
p.cien.consejo: On its own or before a noun: «cien euros». With another number it changes: «ciento uno».
p.ciento.consejo: It covers 101 to 199: «ciento diez», «ciento veinte». Never «ciento y cinco».
p.doscientos.consejo: It agrees with the noun: «doscientos euros», but «doscientas personas».
p.quinientos.consejo: It is irregular: you say «quinientos», never «cincocientos».
p.setecientos.consejo: You say «setecientos», without the i of «siete». Mind the stress: «se-te-THYEN-tos».
p.novecientos.consejo: You say «novecientos», not «nuevecientos». Like the other hundreds, it is a single word.
p.mil.consejo: Never «un mil». And it does not change: «dos mil», «tres mil».
p.un millón.consejo: Before a noun it takes «de»: «un millón de euros».
p.millones.consejo: It loses its accent in the plural and also takes «de»: «tres millones de habitantes».
p.primero.consejo: Before a masculine noun it shortens: «el primer piso». Feminine: «la primera vez».
p.tercero.consejo: It shortens the same way: «el tercer día». Feminine stays whole: «la tercera vez».
p.el piso.consejo: In Spain «piso» also means «flat»: «vivo en un piso». With an ordinal: «el primer piso».
p.el habitante.consejo: The h is silent. It is the same for men and women: «el habitante», «la habitante».
p.el año.consejo: The ñ sounds «ny». Years are read as numbers: «dos mil veinticinco».
b1.titulo: From a hundred to a million
b1.texto:
The number 100 on its own or before a noun is **cien**: **cien euros**. From 101 to 199 use **ciento**: **ciento uno**, **ciento veinte**.

The hundreds are **one word** and agree with the noun: **doscientos**, trescientos, cuatrocientos, **quinientos**, seiscientos, **setecientos**, ochocientos, **novecientos**. Doscient**as** páginas.

**Y** only goes between tens and units: ciento treinta **y** cinco. Never «ciento y cinco».

**Mil** does not change: **dos mil**, **tres mil**. Years are read as ordinary numbers: 2025 is **dos mil veinticinco**.

**Un millón** takes **de** before a noun: **un millón de euros**, **tres millones de habitantes**.
b2.f0.texto: How many inhabitants does your city have?
b2.f1.texto: My city has about five hundred thousand inhabitants.
b2.f2.texto: Madrid has more than three million inhabitants.
b2.f3.texto: I have lived here since the year 2010.
b2.f4.texto: I live on the first floor.
b2.f5.texto: I pay seven hundred euros a month.
b2.f6.texto: My sister lives on the third floor.
b2.f7.texto: Her flat costs a hundred and twenty thousand euros.
b4.texto:
Rules worth remembering:

- **cien** on its own or before a noun; **ciento** when another number follows: **ciento cinco**.
- The hundreds agree in gender: **doscientos euros**, **doscientas personas**.
- **quinientos**, **setecientos** and **novecientos** are irregular.
- **mil** does not change: **dos mil euros**.
- **primero** and **tercero** shorten before a masculine noun: **el primer piso**, **el tercer día**. **Segundo** does not shorten.

In Spain decimals use a comma and thousands are separated with a space: **1 000 000**.
b4.e1.texto: Two hundred people are waiting for the train.
b4.e2.texto: We live on the third floor.
b5.f0.texto: The city wakes under an ashen sky.
b5.f1.texto: Five hundred thousand inhabitants start walking along the narrow streets.
b5.f2.texto: A thousand windows light up one by one like small stars.
b5.f3.texto: The old clock in the square marks eight with a deep sound.
b5.f4.texto: On the third floor of a white house it smells of warm bread.
b5.f5.texto: Grandma has lived in this flat since the year 1970.
b5.f6.texto: Every morning she greets the sparrows from the balcony.
b5.f7.texto: Two hundred pots of red flowers surround the small table.
b5.f8.texto: The first ray of sun draws a golden circle on the wooden floor.
b5.f9.texto: A million memories sleep in every corner of the house.
b6.frase: Pago ____ veinte euros por el billete.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes: from 101 to 199 you use «ciento» followed by the other number.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Cien» stands alone or before a noun, not before another number.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The «y» only goes between tens and units, as in «treinta y cinco».
b6.pregunta: Which word is missing to say 120 euros?
b7.o0.refuerzo: It sounds logical, but it does not exist: it is irregular.
b7.o1.refuerzo: The hundreds are a single word, with no space.
b7.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «Quinientos» is the correct irregular form.
b7.pregunta: How do you write the number 500 in words?
b8.traduccion: I live on the first floor
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Personas» is feminine: so is the hundred.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Correct: the hundred agrees with «personas», feminine plural.
b9.o2.refuerzo: The hundreds are written as one word.
b11.o0.refuerzo: The «y» only goes between tens and units, not after «mil».
b11.o1.refuerzo: Well done! Years are read as ordinary numbers.
b11.pregunta: How do you read the year 2025?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Yes: «primero» shortens before a masculine noun.
p.habitantes.consejo: The h is silent: «a-bi-TAN-tes». The word is the same for men and women: «un habitante», «una habitante».
p.madrid.consejo: Stress on the last syllable: «ma-DRID». The final d is very soft, almost not heard. A city name starts with a capital.
p.tercer.consejo: Short form of «tercero» before a masculine singular noun: «el tercer piso». The c sounds «th».
p.doscientas.consejo: The hundreds agree in gender: «doscientos libros», «doscientas macetas». The «ie» is one syllable.
p.despierta.consejo: From «despertar», but the e becomes «ie»: «despierto», «despiertas», «despierta». «ie» is one syllable.
p.ceniza.consejo: Both the c and the z sound «th» in Spain: «the-NI-tha». «Cielo de ceniza» means a grey sky.
p.empiezan.consejo: From «empezar», but the e becomes «ie»: «empiezo», «empiezas», «empiezan». The z sounds «th».
p.caminar.consejo: Infinitive in -ar, so the stress is on the last syllable: «ka-mi-NAR». Related to «camino», a path.
p.ventanas.consejo: The v sounds like b: «ben-TA-nas». Don't confuse «ventana» (window) with «puerta» (door).
p.encienden.consejo: From «encender», but the e becomes «ie»: «enciendo», «enciendes», «encienden». The c sounds «th».
p.estrellas.consejo: The ll sounds like y: «es-TRE-yas». The plural is made by adding -s to «estrella».
p.gorriones.consejo: The rr is trilled and «io» is one syllable: «go-RRYO-nes». The singular is «gorrión», with an accent.
p.balcón.consejo: The accent mark marks the last syllable: «bal-KON». It loses the accent in the plural: «balcones».
p.macetas.consejo: The c before e sounds «th» in Spain: «ma-THE-tas». Don't confuse it with «maleta», a suitcase.
p.rojas.consejo: The initial r is strong and the j sounds like h: «RRO-has». It agrees with «flores».
p.rodean.consejo: Two strong vowels, e and a, are separate syllables: «rro-DE-an». The first r is strong.
p.dibuja.consejo: From «dibujar»; the j sounds like h: «di-BU-ha». A drawing is «un dibujo».
p.dorado.consejo: Both d sounds are soft, never «th»: «do-RA-do». It comes from «oro», gold.
p.veinticinco.consejo: One word from 16 to 29: «veinti» + number. The v sounds like b and «ei» is one syllable: «bein-ti-THIN-ko».
